files.content:
# Pixel Task List

An offline, pixel-styled task list built with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

## Features

- Add tasks via input field or Enter key
- Blank or whitespace-only input is ignored
- Each task shows a checkbox to toggle completion and a delete button
- Total task count and incomplete task count update in real time
- Tasks receive increasing numeric IDs (e.g., `todo-text-1`, `todo-check-1`, `todo-delete-1`)
- All state is kept in memory; no storage or network requests

## Usage

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. Type a task and press Add or Enter. Toggle checkboxes to mark tasks complete; delete tasks with the Delete button.

## Accessibility

- All controls have visible labels or `aria-label` attributes
- Keyboard navigable with visible focus states
- Screen-reader-only labels for checkboxes and help text

## Files

- `index.html` – structure
- `style.css` – pixel theme and responsive layout
- `app.js` – task logic and DOM updates

No external dependencies, imports, or network requests are used.
